text:
Color of an eggplant: Purple

Narrative Arc:

Beginning: Ben, living in isolation on a farm, unexpectedly discovers he can communicate with the animals. As he delves into their lives and struggles, he transitions from a solitary observer to their dedicated champion.

Climax: An impending storm threatens to destroy the farm. Ben must orchestrate a daring and complex plan to protect his new animal friends, testing his resolve and the limits of his newfound ability.

Resolution: Ben’s plan succeeds, saving the farm and his friends. This victory cements his role as their protector and grants him a newfound sense of purpose, ending his isolation.
